modules.name: Database Management Systems
modules.description: Learn database design, SQL, normalization, and transaction management for building data-driven applications
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand relational database concepts and design principles
LO2: Learn SQL for querying and manipulating data
LO3: Understand database normalization and integrity constraints
LO4: Learn indexing and query optimization techniques
LO5: Understand transaction management and concurrency control

modules.name: Operating Systems
modules.description: Understand operating system concepts including process management, memory management, file systems, and scheduling
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand process management and scheduling algorithms
LO2: Learn memory management techniques including paging and segmentation
LO3: Understand file system organization and I/O management
LO4: Learn synchronization and deadlock handling mechanisms
LO5: Understand virtualization and modern OS concepts

modules.name: Network Design & Management
modules.description: Learn network architecture, protocols, routing, and network management for designing reliable networks
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand network architectures and the OSI/TCP-IP models
LO2: Learn routing and switching protocols
LO3: Understand network security and firewall configurations
LO4: Learn network monitoring and management techniques
LO5: Design scalable and reliable network topologies

modules.name: Database Systems
modules.description: Advanced database concepts including distributed databases, NoSQL, data warehousing, and big data systems
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand advanced SQL and query processing techniques
LO2: Learn distributed database systems and replication strategies
LO3: Understand NoSQL databases and their use cases
LO4: Learn data warehousing and OLAP concepts
LO5: Understand big data processing and modern data architectures

modules.name: Programming Applications
modules.description: Applied programming concepts including data structures, algorithms, and software development methodologies
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand advanced data structures and their applications
LO2: Learn algorithm design and analysis techniques
LO3: Apply design patterns in software development
LO4: Understand testing and debugging methodologies
LO5: Learn software project management and development workflows

modules.name: Professional World
modules.description: Professional skills, ethics, project management, and career development in the IT industry
learning_objectives: LO1: Understand professional ethics and responsibilities in IT
LO2: Learn project management methodologies and tools
LO3: Understand intellectual property and legal aspects of IT
LO4: Develop communication and teamwork skills for the workplace
LO5: Learn career planning and professional development strategies
